purpose: Create one authenticated pending-payment order and matching native inventory reservations with idempotency and compensation.
success_outcome: Real Medusa/PostgreSQL evidence proves one pending order, reservations for every managed line, same-order retry, and no partial success or provider traffic.
anti_goals: No payment-provider call or FT-009 implementation.
No Medusa Core modification, custom inventory database, or direct stock mutation.

forbidden_scope: FT-009 payment-provider calls, webhook, or credentials
production data, secrets, direct browser database access

success_checks: Authenticated actor and cart ownership are enforced.
Native pending order and logical pending_payment metadata are created with a 72-hour expiry.
Every managed line has a native reservation item and no direct stock mutation occurs.
Same idempotency key returns the same order without duplicates.
Failure compensation leaves no successful partial order/reservation state.
T3 markers and semantic-pass evidence are recorded.
evidence_required: Duplicate retry and stock-conflict compensation evidence.
Typecheck/build/lint and full T3 protocol/recovery evidence.

stop_conditions: Real authenticated Medusa/PostgreSQL boundary cannot be exercised.
Reservation allocation needs an unresolved multi-location policy.
Compensation cannot prove no successful partial state.
Implementation requires FT-004, FT-006, FT-008, or FT-009 scope expansion.
